summary: Added shared compact goal-output formatting primitives in src/goal/compact-output.ts with mode-aware options (default concise), strict hierarchy rendering, single-line truncation, top-step capping with '+ N more steps not shown', attempt-badge semantics, Telegram ~15-line budgeting, and reusable section-title/state-indicator helpers. Added focused deterministic tests in src/goal/compact-output.test.ts covering hierarchy/truncation, attempt badges, visual helpers, mode defaults, and Telegram line-budget behavior; verified with vitest, oxlint, oxfmt, and build.
